COMMERCIAL OFFICE PROPERTY LEASE AGREEMENT
Class-A Financial District Office Space Tenancy
Effective Date: December 1, 2025
BETWEEN: Metro Tower Properties REIT ("Landlord") AND Vertex Legal Technologies LLP ("Tenant")
1. LEASED PREMISES AND TERM
1.1 Leased Premises. Landlord hereby leases to Tenant, and Tenant leases from Landlord, Suite 1400 comprising
approximately 8,500 rentable square feet located at 100 Wall Street, New York, NY.
1.2 Term of Tenancy. The initial lease term shall be five (5) years, commencing on January 1, 2026
('Commencement Date') and expiring December 31, 2030, unless renewed pursuant to Section 1.3.
1.3 Option to Renew. Tenant shall have the option to extend the term for one additional period of three (3) years
upon six (6) months prior written notice at Fair Market Value.
2. RENT, ESCALATION AND SECURITY DEPOSIT
2.1 Monthly Base Rent. Tenant shall pay Landlord a monthly base rent of $52,000, payable on the first day of each
calendar month in advance via electronic funds transfer.
2.2 Annual Escalation. On each anniversary of the Commencement Date, base rent shall increase by three and
one-half percent (3.5%) over the preceding lease year.
2.3 Security Deposit. Upon execution, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord $156,000 (three months rent) as security
for full and faithful performance of Tenant's covenants.
3. COMMON AREA MAINTENANCE (CAM) & OPERATING EXPENSES
3.1 Proportionate Share. Tenant shall pay its proportionate share (4.25%) of annual Building Operating Costs,
including real estate taxes, building security, janitorial, and HVAC services.
3.2 Utilities. Tenant shall pay directly for its metered electrical consumption and high-speed fiber telecommunication
services.

--- PAGE BREAK ---

COMMERCIAL OFFICE PROPERTY LEASE AGREEMENT...
4. PERMITTED USE, REPAIRS AND ALTERATIONS
4.1 Permitted Use. The Premises shall be used exclusively for general executive and professional office purposes
and legal software development.
4.2 Maintenance and Repairs. Landlord shall maintain building foundations, exterior walls, and core elevators.
Tenant shall keep interior premises in good order and repair.
4.3 Tenant Alterations. Tenant shall not perform structural modifications without prior written approval from
Landlord, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld.
5. DEFAULT REMEDIES AND CASUALTY
5.1 Events of Default. An event of default occurs if Tenant fails to pay rent within ten (10) days after written notice,
or fails to cure non-monetary default within thirty (30) days.
5.2 Landlord Remedies. Upon default, Landlord may re-enter the Premises, terminate this Lease, and recover all
unpaid rent and consequential re-letting expenses.
5.3 Casualty and Rent Abatement. If premises are rendered untenantable by fire or casualty, rent shall abate
proportionately during restoration period.
6. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
6.1 Governing Law. This Lease shall be governed and construed in accordance with the substantive laws of the
State of New York.
6.2 Waiver of Jury Trial. To the extent permitted by law, Landlord and Tenant waive trial by jury in any action or
proceeding arising out of this Lease.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
